title: kentra-spec-lifecycle living spec
description: Structured YAML source of a capability's living spec (spec-lifecycle change 007, design D1). Markdown (spec.md) is a deterministic read-only projection of this document, never the hand-authored source. requirements and scenarios are ordered sequences; author order is the projection order and is preserved. Kebab-slugs are derived at render time from each name and are never stored in the source.

requirement.description: The requirement/scenario sub-shape shared by the living spec and every spec delta (design D4: shared via $ref). Only name is required at the schema level so a name-only REMOVED delta entry can reuse this shape; content rules (RFC-2119 text, >=1 scenario per ADDED/MODIFIED requirement) are enforced by the content checks retargeted in milestone 2, not by this schema.
